description: This file defines a custom UI component class 'VerticalLabelUI' for rendering vertical labels in a Swing application, with support for rotation and custom painting.

classes.name: VerticalLabelUI
classes.description: A custom Swing UI component for rendering labels vertically, supporting clockwise and counter-clockwise orientations.

methods.name: VerticalLabelUI
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the UI with a specified rotation direction.

methods.name: getPreferredSize
methods.description: Returns the preferred size of the label, swapping width and height for vertical orientation.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Handles custom painting of the label, rotating the graphics context to render text and icon vertically.
